title: Kyoso
tagline: Users select five types of tokens and their ratios to create a portfolio. Other users can buy this portfolio to earn profits. The platform offers seamless token selection and portfolio creation, integrating with Farcaster for enhanced communication and engagement.
description: In this project, users can select five types of tokens and their ratios to create a portfolio. The user who creates the portfolio (Curator) deploys it as a smart contract, and other users (Traders) can buy this portfolio. The platform focuses on seamless token selection and portfolio creation. Integrating with Farcaster enhances communication and engagement among users, providing a unique and enjoyable experience. Additionally, features like Warpcast Frame are provided for Curators and Traders to collaborate with each other, fostering a dynamic and cooperative environment.
how_its_made: The contract was built using Solidity and Hardhat, while the frontend was developed with Next.js. As a partner technology, we utilized the Base Sepolia Testnet. The smart contract is designed to ensure revenue distribution to both the portfolio creators and site administrators. Users can select from a list of portfolios and manage their portfolios independently.
